hero.title: Come closer, look what I've got!
hero.subtitle: Forms you can assemble piece by piece: react-compose-form. Feedback widgets that hang themselves on your site: react-canny. And this one, careful, don't touch! That's motor-js, a graphics engine. It's a bit dusty, but it still works.

packages.title: What I've got
packages.subtitle: Two packages on npm, one on the shelf. Each one has a live demo right here.

motor-js.title: motor-js
motor-js.tagline: A small, dependency-light rendering engine for the web
motor-js.description: motor-js is a lightweight TypeScript rendering engine that draws the same scene through Canvas 2D, SVG, or WebGL — swap backends without rewriting your scene graph. It ships with cameras, geometry primitives, binary space partitioning, and an event system, with gl-matrix as its only dependency. It's an experiment: not on npm, the code is on GitHub and the demo runs right here.
features: Canvas, SVG and WebGL renderers behind one API
Scene graph with cameras, vectors, polygons and basic 3D shapes

react-canny.title: react-canny
react-canny.tagline: Canny.io feedback and changelog widgets for React
react-canny.description: react-canny wraps Canny.io's feedback boards and changelog widgets in ready-to-use React components, with built-in support for authenticated user identification (SSO). Drop in a provider, a feedback board, and a changelog bell, and your users can vote on features and see what shipped — without leaving your app.
features: Feedback board and changelog widgets as React components

react-compose-form.title: react-compose-form
react-compose-form.tagline: Composable form building blocks on top of React Hook Form
react-compose-form.description: react-compose-form lets you bind any custom component to a form field with a single "as" prop, instead of wiring up react-hook-form by hand every time. FormArray gives you repeatable field groups out of the box, and the whole thing is covered by tests and CI.
features: Bind any component as a form field via FormControl
FormArray + useFormArray for repeatable field groups
Built on React Hook Form, fully tested

approach.title: Small tools, used in production
approach.body: Every project here follows the same idea: solve one problem, keep the dependency list short, and make it easy to swap out. This isn't a showcase for its own sake: react-compose-form and react-canny run in this site's own demos, while motor-js sits on the shelf, waiting for me to come back.

cta.title: Wait, my friend, there's more!
cta.subtitle: The storeroom is full: old experiments, little trinkets, half-finished ideas. It's all on GitHub, come and have a look. And if you're after something specific, just say the word, maybe I've got it.
